in_hebrew.name: Marlon
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Marlon הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Marlon is derived from the Latin name Marcellus, which means 'young warrior'. This name was popular among ancient Romans and was often given to boys destined for military careers. In the Christian tradition, the name Marlon is associated with the strength and courage of biblical warriors such as David and Gideon.
